note: Known-absent Jolt env-props refactor. Depends on unported JoltArea3D::apply_override and the merged _update_environmental_properties (base still uses integrate() with separate _update_gravity/_update_damp). Cannot resolve without the unported refactor.

Remove forced area event queuing during body exit. Conflict in jolt_body_3d.cpp only over a pre-existing upstream _areas_changed() call (from unported #118197) inside _clear_areas; base never called it there and _space_changed() calls _areas_changed() anyway, so kept our behavior. Rename _exit_all_areas->_clear_areas and removal of now-unused JoltArea3D::body_exited/area_exited applied cleanly; verified no remaining callers.

ResourceLoader load_threaded_get deadlock fix. Self-contained: new members thread_waiting_on/yielders/resource_dependencies added by the PR's own header change; notify_yield_over, yield, get_caller_task_id, resource_changed_connections all exist in base. Sole cpp conflict was Foundry's qualified enum names (ResourceFormatLoader::CACHE_MODE_*) plus removal of unlock_pending (replaced by thread_load_mutex_held); kept our qualified names and dropped unlock_pending.

Follow-up ResourceLoader deadlock fix (cycle detection + finished_load). Applied cleanly with no conflicts; new bitfield finished_load added by the PR's own header change, resting on base's existing bitfield struct.

Fix screen-space AA when scaling with bilinear filtering. Depends on the unported tonemap bilinear-scaling feature: upstream TonemapSettings has 'bool bilinear_filtering = true' but our fork's tone_mapper.h TonemapSettings lacks it entirely (no bilinear_filtering anywhere in the RD renderer). The PR sets tonemap.bilinear_filtering and its using_scaling_pass logic assumes tonemap-side scaling exists. Porting would require fabricating the unported tonemap shader/struct infrastructure (HDR/tonemap member class of known-absent refactors).
